title: Institutional Racism in the United States Revisited
description: This book aims to examine the current state of systemic racism in the United States as compared to baseline data collected in 1969. Using recent findings in the fields of history, economics, education, political science and public health, the work reveals the ways in which systemic racism in the US has and has not been addressed in the past five decades.
authors: Carmichael Peters - Author / Louis L. Knowles - Author / Rodè F. Cramer - Author / Glennan Keldin - Author / Hayley Nelson - Author
